rule: A nonzero (coefficient, scale) is accepted exactly when Graph Node's BigDecimal::normalized() maps it to itself.

cases.name: v4-base-token-tvl-negative-35-digits
cases.note: Production V4 Base Token TVL: (-1958.23222 * 0.000443428497055167816687599679621575) * 2255.190161262956454194198227130777, with the intermediate re-normalized at the WASM boundary. The engine's decimal.rs oracle test expects this value.

cases.name: graph-negative-one-third-35-digits
cases.note: Graph Node's BigDecimal(-1) / BigDecimal(3).

cases.name: graph-positive-one-third-34-digits
cases.note: Graph Node's BigDecimal(1) / BigDecimal(3).

cases.name: positive-35-digit-one-third-magnitude-refused
cases.note: The positive twin of -1/3. Positive coefficients get a true digit count, so 35 digits are rounded.

cases.name: positive-35-digit-repunit-refused
cases.note: A positive 35-digit coefficient is always rounded to 34 digits.

cases.name: negative-35-digit-repunit-accepted
cases.note: 114 bits: the bit estimate counts 34 digits, so with_prec(34) leaves it unchanged.

cases.name: positive-34-nines
cases.note: The largest positive coefficient.

cases.name: negative-34-nines
cases.note: Every 34-digit negative coefficient is a fixed point.

cases.name: positive-smallest-35-digit-refused
cases.note: 10^34 + 1, 113 bits. Refused because it is positive, not because of its bit length.

cases.name: negative-largest-116-bit-accepted
cases.note: -(2^116 - 1): the largest negative magnitude Graph Node's normalization leaves unchanged.

cases.name: negative-2-pow-116-refused
cases.note: -2^116, 117 bits: the bit estimate counts 35 digits and with_prec truncates one.

cases.name: positive-2-pow-116-minus-one-refused
cases.note: The magnitude the negative side accepts is refused when positive.

cases.name: negative-35-nines-refused
cases.note: -(10^35 - 1), 117 bits. A plain negative 35-digit bound would wrongly accept it.

cases.name: wasm-transient-tvl-intermediate-refused
cases.note: N(-1958.23222 * 0.000443428497055167816687599679621575), 117 bits. Graph Node returns it to the mapping, but every value the mapping passes back is normalized again, so no save of an arithmetic result carries it.

cases.name: wasm-transient-tvl-intermediate-renormalized
cases.note: What a save of that intermediate stores: one more normalization truncates it to 34 digits.

cases.name: raw-to-big-decimal-negative-126-bit-refused
cases.note: What Graph Node stores when a mapping saves BigInt.toBigDecimal() of -(2^126 - 1) with no host arithmetic: the store boundary normalizes the raw value only once. It is not a fixed point, so v1 refuses it deliberately; see docs/block-changes-v1.md.

cases.name: negative-35-digit-trailing-zero
cases.note: Within the 116-bit bound but not stripped of its trailing zero.

cases.name: negative-117-bit-trailing-zero
cases.note: Precision is checked before the trailing zero.
